ideas.title: Following the Money in Medicaid Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the flow of money in Medicaid fraud cases, including the sources of funding and the recipients of fraudulent payments
questions: What are the most common schemes used to commit Medicaid fraud?
How much money is lost to Medicaid fraud each year?
ideas.insight: By following the money, we can gain a better understanding of the scope and complexity of Medicaid fraud and identify potential targets for investigation and prosecution.
